reason: The team already lives in Trello and Slack. Moving boards, client threads and chat to a new tool I've never heard of is a week of grumbling just so I can skip a Monday stand-up I don't actually mind running.
objection: It wants to replace both Trello and Slack at once, and it charges per seat. At five people that's $75 a month when Basecamp does the same pitch for $59 flat, so I'm paying more to take a bigger risk on an unknown.
would_change_my_mind: A one-click import of our Trello boards plus a Slack bridge, so we could try the client pages without anyone having to move chat on day one.
